hook: WHAT IF THE FORTNITE TOKEN HAD\NA BOUNTY ON YOUR HEAD?
cues: Could you actually imagine if you could drop the token after getting it?
Imagine you had to get it and win the game, but then they'd make it a little less rare. That would still be a crazy concept.
Make it how rare it is right now.
Make it known in the lobby that someone has it, and they have a bounty on their head.
And still make it how rare it is right now, but if someone has it, you have to win the game with it.
We would be going to town.
